definitions.explanation: A count of nine people. Usually read きゅうにん today; the older reading くにん survives in set phrases and in some regional speech.

examples.japanese: {九人|きゅうにん}⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九人|きゅうにん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: A baseball team fields nine players.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十人|じゅうにん}→十人：28475_juunin⟧のうち{九人|きゅうにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}した→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: Nine out of ten agreed, so the proposal passed as it was.

notes:
⟦{九|きゅう}→九：00728_kyuu⟧ plus the counter ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ for people.

WHICH READING:
きゅう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ん is the standard modern reading. くにん is older and now mostly limited to fixed expressions; when in doubt, say きゅう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ん.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {九人|きゅうにん}で: as a group of nine
- ⟦{十人|じゅうにん}→十人：28475_juunin⟧のうち{九人|きゅうにん}: nine out of ten
- {九人|きゅうにん}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: nine-a-side (of a sport)

RELATED COUNTS:
- ⟦{八人|はちにん}→八人：30569_hachinin⟧: eight people
- ⟦{十人|じゅうにん}→十人：28475_juunin⟧: ten people
